name: Forest Road 37 (Little Tokyo Road) roadside dispersed sites
coordinateNote: Entrance, parking or campsite coordinates from the November 12, 2026 research.
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: A sand-and-clay forest road heading straight south from SR 40 through scrub toward FR 30 and Farles Prairie. Camping has to be away from the Juniper Springs recreation area itself, so the usable pull-offs start about a mile in. No toilets, water or tables.
access: No reservation needed. Stay limit: 14 days in a 30-day period Ocala WMA general gun season is Nov 14, 2026 - Jan 10, 2027 in the Pipeline, Hopkins Prairie and Lake Delancy units (Church Lake Unit on the far west edge: Nov 14-22 and Nov 28 - Dec 6). FWC 2026-27 brochure: 'During the general gun season, camping is prohibited, except in designated campgrounds and Juniper Prairie Wilderness.' Forest Service: 'Camping is allowed only in designated campsites during general gun season.' So roadside dispersed camping here is NOT legal on any night of Nov 21 - Dec 8, 2026; it was legal in late October. Deer hunters must wear 500 sq in of fluorescent orange; wear orange yourself if you walk outside a campground.

conditions.summary: Dispersed camping is prohibited during general gun season, Nov 14, 2026 - Jan 10, 2027 (this road is in the Pipeline Unit). Legal again from Jan 11, 2027. (source dated read 2026-11-12)

camp.sedanNote: Forest Service road data: improved native material, maintenance level 3 'suitable for passenger cars' for the first 1.6 miles south of SR 40, then high-clearance only beyond that. OpenStreetMap tags the surface as sand, so treat it as firm only when dry and do not go past the first 1.6 miles in a low sedan.
camp.carSleepingNote: FWC brochure: 'Camping is allowed throughout the year. Use of trailers or self-propelled camping vehicles is prohibited except in designated campgrounds.' Neither FWC nor the Forest Service says whether sleeping inside a passenger car counts.
camp.huntingNote: Ocala WMA general gun season is Nov 14, 2026 - Jan 10, 2027 in the Pipeline, Hopkins Prairie and Lake Delancy units (Church Lake Unit on the far west edge: Nov 14-22 and Nov 28 - Dec 6). FWC 2026-27 brochure: 'During the general gun season, camping is prohibited, except in designated campgrounds and Juniper Prairie Wilderness.' Forest Service: 'Camping is allowed only in designated campsites during general gun season.' So roadside dispersed camping here is NOT legal on any night of Nov 21 - Dec 8, 2026; it was legal in late October. Deer hunters must wear 500 sq in of fluorescent orange; wear orange yourself if you walk outside a campground.
